Introduction

Xu Jia Qi is a Chinese idol singer under STAR48, its sub label STAR48 Culture Media and ZB Label. She is a graduated member of the Chinese idol group SNH48 (Team SII) and active member of its sub-unit 7SENSES. She is a former member of the Chinese project girl group THE9 before their disbandment in 2021.
